svg.text: Every number in a grid is an offset: where that element sits in memory, counting from 0.
Before the colon is the shape (how many of each); after it is the stride (how far one step moves). Read them in pairs, by position.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 4 rows × 8 columns. The inner (2, 2) means the row number is
counted by two counters, i0 and i1, each 0 or 1, like the two
digits of a number: row = i0 + 2·i1. The inner (1, 16) gives

svg.text: Outlined: row 3, column 2 → i0 = 1, i1 = 1, c = 2
Rows 0 and 1 interleave (even and odd offsets 0–15);
the shaded rows 2 and 3 do the same, 16 further on.
A single row stride could not describe this.
